source.source_text: Purpose: apply bounded textual patch under an authorized project root. Input: project_root:string, patch:string, expected_base_hash?:string. Output: changed paths, precondition result, post-write hashes and verification. Contract: L2 writes_local; scopes mac.files.write + mac.project.write; target project_root; timeout 30000ms; cap 512KiB; network none; filesystem write_allowed_project; secret paths/content denied; approval trusted_write; non-idempotent unless expected hash makes retry safe. Phase 3 planned.
